content.description: JSON segments: [{"t":"text","v":"As shown by "},{"t":"cite","works":["<paper id>"],"locator":"p. 4"},{"t":"text","v":"."}] (text may carry "b" or "i": true; {"t":"claim","node":"<id>"} links a claim; {"t":"math","v":"x^2"} is inline LaTeX maths; {"t":"ref","block":"<heading, equation, figure or table>"} reads "Figure 2", with "bare":true "2"). An equation holds its LaTeX as text; a figure or table holds its caption.

data.description: What a figure, table or LaTeX block holds beyond its text, JSON: figure {"file":"<repository file: png, jpg or pdf>","width":80} (width in % of the text width); table {"rows":[["Strain","OD600"],["WT","1.12"]],"header":true,"align":["left","right"]}; latex {"code":"\\begin{tabular}..."}

typed.description: Characters typed since the last save

pasted.description: Characters pasted since the last save

operations.name: ms.delete-block
operations.description: Delete a block. [People only.]

operations.name: ms.move-block
operations.description: Move a block after another ("start" for the top). [People only.]

operations.name: ms.propose
operations.description: Propose a tracked change: insert a block (after --after or at the start), replace a block, or delete one. The person keeps or undoes it. Citations must name citable papers.

after.description: Insert after this block ("start" for the top)

content.description: JSON segments: [{"t":"text","v":"As shown by "},{"t":"cite","works":["<paper id>"],"locator":"p. 4"},{"t":"text","v":"."}] (text may carry "b" or "i": true; {"t":"claim","node":"<id>"} links a claim; {"t":"math","v":"x^2"} is inline LaTeX maths; {"t":"ref","block":"<heading, equation, figure or table>"} reads "Figure 2", with "bare":true "2"). An equation holds its LaTeX as text; a figure or table holds its caption.

data.description: What a figure, table or LaTeX block holds beyond its text, JSON: figure {"file":"<repository file: png, jpg or pdf>","width":80} (width in % of the text width); table {"rows":[["Strain","OD600"],["WT","1.12"]],"header":true,"align":["left","right"]}; latex {"code":"\\begin{tabular}..."}

operations.name: ms.keep
operations.description: Keep your AI agent's changes (a change to a block edited since is stale). [People only.]

operations.name: ms.undo
operations.description: Undo (discard) proposed changes. [People only.]

operations.name: ms.snapshot
operations.description: Save a labelled snapshot of the text as it is (your AI agent: before proposing large changes).

operations.name: ms.snapshots
operations.description: Snapshots of a manuscript.

operations.name: ms.restore
operations.description: Go back to a snapshot (the current version is snapshotted first). [People only.]

operations.name: ms.set-status
operations.description: Mark a manuscript ready (refused while sources are unresolved, unconfirmed or retracted, unless --acknowledge_retracted) or back to draft. [People only.]

operations.name: ms.export
operations.description: Export: LaTeX (main.tex and references.bib, with the figures and style files to put beside them as assets), Markdown with references.bib and its figures, plain text, or the model a Word file is built from. The PDF comes from ms.build.

operations.name: responses.list
operations.description: Reviews received for a manuscript, each with its comments (type, strategy, status, response, linked change).

operations.name: responses.add-review
operations.description: Paste a review received. [People only.]

operations.name: responses.update-review
operations.description: Change a review's label or text. [People only.]

operations.name: responses.delete-review
operations.description: Delete a review and its comments. [People only.]

operations.name: responses.add-items
operations.description: Comments of a review: JSON [{"comment":"..","kind":"major","strategy":"accept","response":".."}] (kinds: major, minor, typo, misunderstanding, praise; strategies: accept, defend, clarify, experiment). Yours wait for a person.

operations.name: responses.update
operations.description: A comment's type, strategy, response, linked change (a manuscript block) and status; addressed needs a linked change.

change_block.description: The block that changed for it

operations.name: responses.delete-item
operations.description: Delete a comment (your AI agent: only its own unconfirmed ones).

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the person asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: responses.letter
operations.description: The response letter as Markdown.

operations.name: screen.list
operations.description: A project's systematic reviews with their PRISMA counts.

operations.name: screen.summary
operations.description: A review: protocol, PRISMA 2020 counts, agreement between the person and your AI agent (Cohen kappa).

operations.name: screen.create
operations.description: Start a systematic review in a project: question, criteria, exclusion reasons, dual screening with your AI agent as the blinded second screener. [People only.]

blind.description: Hide the other decision until you decide (default true)

agent_seat.description: Your AI agent is the second screener (default true)

operations.name: screen.update
operations.description: Change a review's protocol or settings. [People only.]

operations.name: screen.delete
operations.description: Delete a review, its records and decisions. [People only.]

operations.name: screen.import
operations.description: Records into a review: --from reading_list, --works, --collection, --import (a previewed RIS or BibTeX file), or --pubmed "query". Duplicates by DOI or PubMed ID are marked.

query.description: The search string used (for the methods)

operations.name: screen.records
operations.description: Records by state (ta, ft), with decisions (blinded ones hidden from people until they decide).

operations.name: screen.next
operations.description: The next record this seat has not decided at a stage (abstract with its word count), or the next conflict.

operations.name: screen.decide
operations.description: Decide a record: include, exclude or maybe (full text: include or exclude, with a reason to exclude). Your AI agent adds --basis_words "a-b" (words of the abstract), --rationale and --confidence. People resolve conflicts with --seat final.

basis_words.description: Your AI agent: word span of the abstract the decision rests on

operations.name: screen.undo-decision
operations.description: Take back this seat's decision on a record.

operations.name: screen.mark-duplicate
operations.description: Mark a record as a duplicate of another ("" clears it). [People only.]

operations.name: screen.export
operations.description: Every record with its decisions as CSV.

operations.name: tasks.list
operations.description: A project's to-do list (or every project's when --project is left out), open tasks by default; filter by status, who it is for, when it is due, a label or words.

q.description: Words in the title or notes

operations.name: tasks.get
operations.description: One task with its checklist, labels and linked records.

operations.name: tasks.summary
operations.description: Open tasks across active projects (or one project): counts by due day (overdue, today, this week), in progress, waiting, for your AI agent, per project, and what comes next (in one project: every open task, by day then priority).

operations.name: tasks.create
operations.description: Add a task to a project's to-do list. --assignee agent hands it to your AI agent (not in confidential projects).

checklist.description: JSON list of steps: ["Re-run the baseline", {"text":"Plot the results","done":true}] (keep an item's "id" to keep it)

links.description: JSON list of the project's records: [{"kind":"work","id":"<paper>"},{"kind":"node","id":"<claim>"}] (kinds: work, node, manuscript, board, note, experiment)

operations.name: tasks.update
operations.description: Change a task: title, notes, status, priority, due day ("" clears it), who it is for, labels, checklist, links or repeat.

checklist.description: JSON list of steps: ["Re-run the baseline", {"text":"Plot the results","done":true}] (keep an item's "id" to keep it)

links.description: JSON list of the project's records: [{"kind":"work","id":"<paper>"},{"kind":"node","id":"<claim>"}] (kinds: work, node, manuscript, board, note, experiment)

operations.name: tasks.complete
operations.description: Tick a task off (--done false reopens it). A repeating task makes its next one.

operations.name: tasks.move
operations.description: Move a task to a status column and place it ("start", after a task id, or at the end).

operations.name: tasks.check
operations.description: Tick or untick one checklist item (--item), or add an item (--text).

operations.name: tasks.delete
operations.description: Delete a task (Activity can undo it).

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the person asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: exp.list
operations.description: A project's experiments: status, outcome, tags, dates, the next protocol step, runs and journal counts, lineage.

operations.name: exp.get
operations.description: One experiment: objective, design (variables, materials), protocol with ticks, links, status and dates, outcome and conclusion, what it repeats and its repeats.

operations.name: exp.runs
operations.description: An experiment's runs (values keyed by variable id; the variables come with them).

operations.name: exp.entries
operations.description: An experiment's journal, oldest first: kind, what it is about (step or run), corrections, strike-throughs, late entries, files (with file_path for your AI agent).

operations.name: exp.results
operations.description: Per measure, n, mean, SD, min and max (or counts for text, categories and yes/no) by condition group, from done runs.

by.description: The conditions that make the groups: variable ids, or a JSON list of names (default all; the rest pool, e.g. seeds or batches as replicates; [] pools every run)

operations.name: exp.export
operations.description: The runs as CSV: a column per condition and measure, with units.

operations.name: exp.file
operations.description: A file attached to a journal entry (your AI agent gets its file_path).

name.description: Stored file name, as exp.entries lists it

operations.name: exp.templates
operations.description: Templates (plans and protocols kept for reuse), usable in every project.

operations.name: exp.create
operations.description: Plan a new experiment in a project (numbered EXP-001, EXP-002...), blank or from a template.

title.description: Title (from a template: defaults to its name)

aim.description: What it sets out to find

variables.description: JSON list of variables: [{"name":"Temperature","role":"condition","type":"number","unit":"°C","levels":["20","30","37"]},{"name":"Medium","role":"constant","value":"LB broth"},{"name":"OD600","role":"measure","type":"number"}] (roles: condition = varied, constant = held fixed, measure = recorded; types: number, text, category with "options", yesno). Keep a variable's "id" to keep its data.

steps.description: JSON list of protocol steps: ["Prepare 50 mM Tris, pH 7.4", {"text":"Incubate at 37 °C","minutes":30}] (minutes = a timer in bench mode; keep a step's "id" to keep its tick)

materials.description: JSON list: [{"name":"Tris buffer","detail":"50 mM, pH 7.4"},{"name":"Python","detail":"3.12, numpy 2.1"}]

links.description: JSON list of what it tests: [{"kind":"node","id":"<claim or question>"},{"kind":"work","id":"<paper>"}]

operations.name: exp.repeat
operations.description: Run an experiment again: a new planned experiment with the same objective, design and protocol (unticked), linked to the original. Runs, journal and conclusion start empty.

operations.name: exp.update
operations.description: Change an experiment: title, kind, aim, hypothesis, variables, steps, materials, links, tags, planned dates, pin, or status (running stamps the start, done or cancelled the end; the journal notes each change).

variables.description: JSON list of variables: [{"name":"Temperature","role":"condition","type":"number","unit":"°C","levels":["20","30","37"]},{"name":"Medium","role":"constant","value":"LB broth"},{"name":"OD600","role":"measure","type":"number"}] (roles: condition = varied, constant = held fixed, measure = recorded; types: number, text, category with "options", yesno). Keep a variable's "id" to keep its data.

steps.description: JSON list of protocol steps: ["Prepare 50 mM Tris, pH 7.4", {"text":"Incubate at 37 °C","minutes":30}] (minutes = a timer in bench mode; keep a step's "id" to keep its tick)

materials.description: JSON list: [{"name":"Tris buffer","detail":"50 mM, pH 7.4"},{"name":"Python","detail":"3.12, numpy 2.1"}]

links.description: JSON list of what it tests: [{"kind":"node","id":"<claim or question>"},{"kind":"work","id":"<paper>"}]

pinned.description: Pinned to the top of the list

operations.name: exp.step
operations.description: Tick (or untick with --done false) a protocol step of a started experiment; the journal notes it with the time.

operations.name: exp.delete
operations.description: Delete an experiment with its runs, journal and files (--preview shows what goes). Its repeats stay. [People only.]

operations.name: exp.add-runs
operations.description: Record runs (trials, samples, participants, simulations). A run with a measured value is done unless a status says otherwise. Record only values that were measured or computed.

csv.description: Or CSV / tab-separated text: a header row of variable names (Status and Note columns optional), then one row per run

operations.name: exp.plan-runs
operations.description: Plan one run for every combination of condition levels, times replicates (--preview counts them).

operations.name: exp.update-run
operations.description: Change a run: values (merged; "" clears one), status or note. Measuring a planned run makes it done.

values.description: JSON object of values by variable name

operations.name: exp.delete-runs
operations.description: Remove runs (Activity can bring them back).

confirm.description: Your AI agent: true once the person asked for this deletion. Without it nothing is deleted and the answer says what would be.

operations.name: exp.log
operations.description: Write in an experiment's journal: a note, observation, result, deviation or issue, about a step or a run when given, with files (people upload; your AI agent gives --paths). An entry dated earlier shows as a late entry.

paths.description: JSON list of absolute paths of files to attach (your AI agent)

operations.name: exp.correct
operations.description: Correct a journal entry's text or kind. The original stays in its history with the reason. The app's own entries stay as written.

operations.name: exp.strike
operations.description: Strike a journal entry through with a reason. It stays legible in the journal; nothing is erased.

operations.name: exp.conclude
operations.description: The outcome (supports, refutes, inconclusive, failed), what the data show, and next steps. Your AI agent's conclusion stays proposed until a person keeps it.

summary.description: What the data show: effects with n, caveats

operations.name: exp.save-template
operations.description: Keep an experiment's objective, design and protocol as a template for any project.

operations.name: exp.delete-template
operations.description: Remove a template (experiments made from it keep their copy). [People only.]

operations.name: repo.list
operations.description: A project's whole repository: every folder and file with its path, size, version and how the app shows it. ready false means its starter repository is not made yet (repo.init makes it).

operations.name: repo.get
operations.description: One folder (with what is directly inside it) or file (with its versions).

operations.name: repo.versions
operations.description: A file's versions, newest first: who made each and when.

operations.name: repo.read
operations.description: A text file's content (up to 2 MB: notes, code, CSV, Markdown). For other files, repo.file gives where the file is on this machine.

operations.name: repo.file
operations.description: The file itself, or an earlier version. Pages show pictures, PDFs, sound, video and text in place; your AI agent gets where the file is on this machine (disk_path).

operations.name: repo.init
operations.description: Make a project's starter repository (README.md, data/raw, data/processed, code, results, docs) if it was never made. New projects get it when they are made.

operations.name: repo.mkdir
operations.description: Make a folder. A path such as "results/figures/2026" makes each folder that is missing.

folder.description: Inside which folder (Folder: its id or path, e.g. "data/raw" ("" or left out: the top))

operations.name: repo.upload
operations.description: Put files in a folder (at most 100 at a time, 1 GB each). A file whose name is already there becomes its next version; the one before is kept. People upload; your AI agent gives --paths.

folder.description: Folder: its id or path, e.g. "data/raw" ("" or left out: the top)

path.description: Subfolders to make under the folder first, e.g. "run-3/plates" (a folder upload)

paths.description: JSON list of absolute paths of files on this machine (your AI agent)

operations.name: repo.write
operations.description: Write a text file (notes, code, CSV, Markdown; up to 2 MB): a new one with --name in --folder, or a new version of one with --item (the one before is kept).

folder.description: Folder: its id or path, e.g. "data/raw" ("" or left out: the top)

item.description: An existing text file (writes its next version)

content.description: The whole text of the file ("" for an empty file)

operations.name: repo.rename
operations.description: Rename a file or folder (names cannot hold / \ : * ? " < > |).

operations.name: repo.move
operations.description: Move files and folders into another folder of the same project.

items.description: Item ids (JSON list or one id)

to.description: Into which folder (Folder: its id or path, e.g. "data/raw" ("" or left out: the top))

operations.name: repo.delete
operations.description: Delete files and folders, with everything inside them and every earlier version. [Proposal: a person approves.]

items.description: Item ids (JSON list or one id)

why.description: Your AI agent: why, in a sentence or two, for the person approving

operations.name: repo.restore
operations.description: Make an earlier version of a file the current one; the current one is kept as a version too.
